newsitem.title: IRAN: Khatami visits late Iranian leader's tomb.
newsitem.headline: Khatami visits late Iranian leader's tomb.

text.p: Iran's president-elect Mohammad Khatami on Monday visited the mausoleum of late spiritual leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini and renewed his allegiance to the ideals of the Islamic revolution.
The official Iranian news IRNA said Khatami, accompanied by Khomeini's grandson, "laid a wreath on the tomb of the late imam and renewed allegiance with his ideals".
It said he also visited the tombs of some martyrs of the Islamic revolution.
The relatively moderate Khatami won Friday's polls by a landslide in what turned out to be Iran's fiercest election campaign since the 1979 revolution led by Khomeini.
